summary: Fourteen days of Nightscout data with 98.7 percent CGM coverage, 5-minute cadence and no invalid or duplicate entries. Aggregate glucose is 121.6 mg/dL with 86.0 percent time in range, 8.9 percent above, 5.1 percent below and a coefficient of variation of 32.6 percent. The distribution is strongly time-of-day dependent: local hours 13:00 to 17:00 carry 16 to 32 percent time above range with a peak hourly mean of 162.8 mg/dL at 16:00, while local hours 18:00 to 03:00 carry the hypoglycemia burden, notably 15.3 percent below range at 19:00 and 18.5 percent at 01:00. No carbohydrates were recorded in the entire period: carb_entries is 0, total_carbs_g is 0.0, carb_treatment_entries is empty, extended_carb_entries is 0 and every sampled loop status reports COB 0. All 24 therapy response windows are correction boluses with is_extended_carbs false. Insulin totals 275.95 U over 655 entries, approximately 19.7 U per day, against a profile basal of 16.2 U per day, so unannounced correction and UAM dosing supplies the majority of insulin. Dynamic ISF is enabled with a 70 percent adjustment factor over a flat profile ISF of 56 mg/dL/U, and the effective variable sensitivity observed spans 27.8 to 124 mg/dL/U, crossing the static value near 170 to 190 mg/dL. Insulin on board reached 4.73 U and 5.935 U with zero carbs on board. The period also contains three GLP-1 doses, one occlusion and pump error, three site changes, two sensor changes and one profile switch, all of which limit how stationary the underlying sensitivity can be assumed to be.
